# The same customer's second invoice, paid the same day, for the same figure,
# into the same account — and saying on its bank line which payment it is.
#
# Everything else agrees with a_second_invoice_of_the_same_owner.txt, which
# copies the first invoice's memo as well and is refused for it. A memo is what
# a payment block carries to name the movement it is about, so stating a
# different one is the file saying these are two movements, and it is read that
# way.
customer "C-SPELL"
	name: "Spelling Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-SPELL-2"
	customer_id: "C-SPELL"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-SPELL-2"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-15
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Paid the second"
		txn_guid: "0ff1ce0ff1ce0ff1ce0ff1ce0ff1ce00"
